description: 3 checks in 1 call: token-risk + wallet-intelligence + agent-health, the three questions an agent asks before trusting a new counterparty - is the token safe, is the wallet funded and payment-ready, is the agent's own service actually live. One overall_verdict plus each check's full result. address/token/url are each optional (give whichever you have) - an omitted one is marked skipped, never guessed. Try GET /due-diligence/sample.

address.description: Wallet address to check with wallet-intelligence, and the default token address for token-risk unless `token` is given separately.

amount_usdc.description: Amount to compare with the Base USDC balance for wallet-intelligence's x402 readiness.

method.description: HTTP method for the agent-health target; defaults to GET.

networks.description: Up to five networks for wallet-intelligence; defaults to all supported EVM networks.

token.description: ERC-20 contract address on Base to analyze with token-risk, if different from `address`.

url.description: Public agent/API endpoint to audit with agent-health.

name: due_diligence

address.description: The wallet address checked, if given.

agent_health.description: Same shape as POST /agent-health's response, or {status: skipped/error} if no url was given or the call failed.

agent_url.description: The agent endpoint checked, if given.

overall_verdict.description: Rollup of the 3 legs' own verdicts - 'avoid' beats 'caution' beats 'acceptable'.

token.description: The token address checked, if given.

token_risk.description: Same shape as POST /token-risk's response, or {status: skipped/error} if no address/token was given or the call failed.

wallet_intelligence.description: Same shape as POST /wallet-intelligence's response, or {status: skipped/error} if no address was given or the call failed.

x402_receipt.description: Billing and provenance receipt for this call.

title: Due Diligence
